input_ref: short-partial | Pharmacy advocate: what do I say before I quote a cost

output.reason: None of the units says what to tell the member before quoting a cost. U-RX-EDU-001-05 is the closest, but it only covers checking caregiver authorization when a caregiver is on the line. It does not cover what to say before a price quote in general. The other two units cover greeting delivery and confirming the drug captured by the IVR.
